record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: How should one compare deformations of complex manifolds with boundary with families of cobordisms?

evidence.quote: Question 3. Compare the notion of deformations of manifolds with boundaries with the notion of families of cobordisms.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a compact complex manifold with smooth boundary ∂X (more generally, a compactifiable complex manifold, i.e. the interior of a compact complex manifold with boundary). One has a notion of analytic deformation of X as a complex manifold with boundary: a proper holomorphic submersion 𝒳 → S of complex spaces (with corners along the boundary) whose central fiber is X, equipped with a trivialization of the boundary family ∂𝒳 → S. On the other hand, in differential topology one has the notion of a family of cobordisms parametrized by a base S, namely a smooth proper submersion 𝒲 → S whose fibers are cobordisms (manifolds with boundary, with the boundary decomposed into incoming and outgoing components), considered up to an appropriate equivalence.

Problem. Develop a precise comparison between these two notions. Concretely:

(a) Define a functor from the category (or moduli stack) of holomorphic deformations of a complex manifold with boundary X to a category of smooth families of cobordisms over the same base, by forgetting the complex structure and recording the underlying smooth bordism data.

(b) Determine to what extent this functor is faithful, full, or essentially surjective. In particular, characterize which smooth families of cobordisms arise from holomorphic deformations, and describe the obstructions to lifting a given smooth family of cobordisms to a holomorphic deformation.

(c) Relate the deformation-theoretic invariants (Kodaira–Spencer classes, tangent and obstruction spaces of deformations of manifolds with boundary) to topological/cobordism-theoretic invariants of the associated family of cobordisms.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of a list of open research problems on deformations of compactifiable complex manifolds (2020). No subsequent work explicitly establishing the comparison between deformations of complex manifolds with boundary and families of cobordisms was located in the literature; the topic remains an active area without a published resolution.

status_evidence.title: On Deformations of Compactifiable Complex Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Classical work (Kawamata) on deformations of compactifiable complex manifolds, predating modern cobordism-family formulations.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature treats deformations of compactifiable manifolds but does not provide the requested comparison with families of cobordisms.
